what: `blaze-history` panicked in arrow (`generic_bytes_builder.rs:94: byte array offset overflow`) two minutes into reth's cold build on a machine short of memory, and by the same symptom in tempo's: after it `builds` held one row, `running`, and every why query read a history that stopped. A flush made one batch of all it had read (up to 2 M rows when behind), each span with its key as text.
cost: an hour of builds with no rows, twice; the coordinator's tempo run had no `misses`
cause: an unbounded batch, and a thread with no containment
class: a panic that ends a daemon's thread for good (rule panics-fail-one-job)
prevention: built: History::flush_contained (f8d7610c54: the flush's rows dropped, said, the thread goes on) and batches of at most 65,536 rows for spans, events and event_fields (e28fb8bc89). Not reproduced: the overflowing table left no backtrace
